data.short_description: Bray's Hamburgers is a family-owned Metro Detroit burger chain founded by Roy Bray, slogan "Detroit's original burger spot," serving hamburgers, cheeseburgers, sandwiches, coneys, and sides. Owner Agron Duhanaj told What Now Detroit the Clinton Township restaurant at 1187 Southbound Gratiot Avenue will open around August 1. Duhanaj also operates the Flat Rock and Port Huron locations and is seeking additional expansion opportunities.

Bray's Hamburgers is a family-owned Metro Detroit burger chain founded by Roy Bray, known for burgers, sandwiches, coneys, and sides. An additional company-owned location is coming to 4365 Auburn Road in Shelby Township, with no opening timeline confirmed at time of publication. The Shelby Township location is part of the brand's rapid expansion in Metro Detroit alongside the new Clinton Township spot.

Ocean Crab is a new seafood restaurant preparing to open near Orlando Sanford International Airport. It will open at 2935 S Orlando Drive, replacing the former WingHouse Bar & Grill, with the opening expected next month. The opening was confirmed with a restaurant representative by What Now on Thursday.

The Washington Square location will be one of the brand's first in the Portland metro area.

Twin Peaks is a restaurant chain known for food, drinks, and scenic views, opening its first-ever Kissimmee location. It is taking over the former Smokey Bones space at 2911 Vineland Rd in Poinciana Place shopping center, with the company having invested $4 million in the transformation. The new location plans to hire 130 people.

Ross Dress for Less is a national off-price retail chain known for discounted apparel and home goods. The addition of this new DD's location would further extend the company's reach in lower-price-point retail categories in San Diego.

data.location: 406 W Belt Line Rd, Cedar Hill, TX 75104
data.short_description: Mija Barbecue is a family-owned barbecue restaurant in Cedar Hill, Texas, that began as a backyard project before growing into a brick-and-mortar business in 2024. It will permanently close on June 27, 2026, with the owners sharing the news via social media and thanking the community for years of support. The announcement did not provide a specific reason for the closure.

Crackin Blue Crabs is an upcoming food truck promising "All Flavor No Flex," with a focus on fried and grilled seafood. Plan review paperwork was submitted by Crackin Blue Crabs LLC, but no opening timeline or location has been confirmed. Co-owner Latasha Armstrong was not immediately available for comment at the time of publication.

Sheep is a new rooftop dining concept planned by Id Est Hospitality Group founder Kelly Whitaker, also co-owner of The Wolf's Tailor. It will open on the sixth-floor rooftop of the Clayton Hotel & Members Club at 233 Clayton Street in Cherry Creek, Denver, as a three-month residency from July to October. Guests can expect a nightly four-course menu designed by Whitaker and chef Taylor Stark.

McDonald's is opening a new location in Magog on Rue Sherbrooke, across from Walmart, expected to open in Fall 2026. The new restaurant will be operated by franchise owner Caroline Iannuzzi, who currently operates seven McDonald's restaurants across the Estrie region. Construction is already underway on the vacant site along Rue Sherbrooke.

Gringos Tacos is an upcoming food truck serving Flagler County, featuring birria tacos and ramen by Chef Chris Gibbs. Plan review paperwork was recently submitted by Dos Bros Foods LLC, but Chef Gibbs was not immediately available for comment on the launch timeline. No specific address or opening date has been confirmed.

Planet Fitness has opened a new 21,141-square-foot fitness center in Sammamish at 3066 228th Avenue SE, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony scheduled for June 18, 2026. The location is the brand's 19th in the Seattle-Tacoma area and offers affordable memberships, free fitness training, and various recovery amenities for Black Card members. The facility is operated by CDM Fitness Holdings, one of the largest Planet Fitness franchisees.

Palazzo Pizza Italiana is a pizza restaurant headed up by Jason Fox and the team at Josephine's Italian Market. It will open at 214 E Cass St in Downtown Tampa this summer, featuring a moody interior with a room-length bar and large semi-circular booths. A previous instantiation of Palazzo Pizza on West Platt Street was active until May 2024.

Franchise owner Caroline Iannuzzi, who currently operates seven McDonald's restaurants in the Estrie region, will oversee the new restaurant as her eighth franchise.
